timing: Specified during frozen matrix training, before inspecting its test scores or running real-data clustering/ranking. Not an independent-test registration.

clustering.selection: Maximum source-training silhouette, smaller K on ties within 1e-12; never query/test selection.

bootstrap_scope: All six conditions and all 15 folds, neural seed 0, source-series resampling at fixed encoder and source-selected K.
seed_stability: All three neural seed pairs per condition/fold; ARI only on common accepted queries with at least two clusters in each assignment, otherwise missing with denominator/reason.
naming: Numeric cluster IDs only; no geographic place-to-duty mapping; three nearest source examples per cluster.
limitations: Source-window silhouette and radius are descriptive, not validated tactical relevance or calibrated confidence.
Shared teams, repeated matches and conditional encoder fits limit inference.
Independent P4-P5 test and tactical judgments remain pending.
